name: How do I care for and seal a newly installed bathroom countertop?

mainEntity.name: How do I care for and seal a newly installed bathroom countertop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Natural stones like marble and granite require a quality penetrating stone sealer applied immediately after installation, with reapplication every one to two years depending on usage. Sealing clogs microscopic pores so hair dyes, makeup, and hard water minerals cannot soak into the stone. Quartz and solid surface materials do not require sealers. For routine maintenance on all surfaces, clean with mild dish soap and warm water or a pH-neutral stone cleaner, avoiding harsh abrasive pads and acidic cleaners like vinegar or bleach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Seal natural stone like granite or marble every 1 to 2 years using a penetrating sealer. Quartz needs no sealing. Clean surfaces daily with pH-neutral soap and water.
